messages:
Aisha Kapoor: @here Quick org update — small leadership & squad alignment effective Mon 2026-05-04.

Aisha Kapoor: We're adjusting the Runtime/Platform boundary to cut cross-team handoffs. This is intended to speed up feature delivery for inference optimizations and runtime reliability.

Liam Chen: Can you share the new reporting lines? :eyes:

Aisha Kapoor: TL;DR — Runtime will split into Runtime-Core (ownership: low-latency paths, scheduling) led by Liam, and Runtime-Inference (ownership: model-specific optimizations, KV cache, quantization) led by Tomás. Platform infra will now house the batching & orchestration squad under Maya.

Sofia Rivera: Congrats Tomás & Liam! Any headcount or budget changes tied to this?

Aisha Kapoor: Two immediate backfills approved: 1x Senior MLE (Inference) and 1x Staff SWE (Platform orchestration). Both are permanent headcount; recruiting kicks off this week.

People Ops Bot: Reminder: managers, please update direct reports in the org tool and schedule team all-hands. Org chart: https://okta.redwood/internal/org-chart

Maya Patel: Note to squads — SLAs and routing policies remain the same. This is a reporting / ownership clarity change, not a product or infra policy change.

Tomás Alvarez: Honored to lead Runtime-Inference. I'll circulate a 30/60/90 plan tomorrow focusing on latency regressions, KV cache hit-rate experiments, and a quantization validation pipeline.

Liam Chen: I'll coordinate cross-team rollout windows and maintain the deployment calendar so we avoid overlapping model rollouts.

Sofia Rivera: Hiring ask — can People Ops post the Senior MLE role to our public and internal boards? I can help draft the JD and interview loop.

Aisha Kapoor: Action items: (1) People Ops to post JDs + craft interview loop (Sofia assist); (2) Liam/Tomás/Maya to run team Q&As this week; (3) Eng leads to map roadmap ownership and update Confluence. Ping me with any disputes.

Liam Chen: 👍

Tomás Alvarez: 👍 excited to get started.

Sofia Rivera: On it — will DM Aisha a JD draft by EOD.

Aisha Kapoor: Thanks all — we'll post a follow-up note with org chart snippet and FAQ later today.
